SELECT oi.product_id AS productId, MAX(oi.product_name) AS productName, SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND (o.cancel_time IS NULL OR o.cancel_time > o.pay_time) AND o.pay_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.pay_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS salesVolume, SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND o.cancel_time IS NOT NULL AND o.cancel_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.cancel_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END) AS refundVolume, SUM(CASE WHEN o.pay_time IS NOT NULL AND (o.cancel_time IS NULL OR o.cancel_time > o.pay_time) AND o.pay_time >= CONCAT(#{startDate}, ' 00:00:00') AND o.pay_time <= CONCAT(#{endDate}, ' 23:59:59') THEN oi.total_price ELSE 0 END) AS salesAmount FROM order_item oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id
AND oi.product_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
GROUP BY oi.product_id ORDER BY salesVolume DESC
LIMIT #{topN}
